title: WILD POISE
subtitle: Double-Chained Black Metal Jaguar Brooch
description: A striking jaguar brooch sculpted in black metal and finished with a distinctive double-chain detail. Bold yet refined, its dark finish and sculptural form bring a confident edge to both contemporary and traditional dressing.

title: PHOENIX RENEWAL — RISE
subtitle: Red Phoenix Brooch
description:
For those ready to rise into what comes next.

A striking phoenix brooch in a rich red finish, capturing the mythical bird in an elegant, upward-reaching silhouette. Its vivid colour and sculptural form make it a distinctive statement piece for both contemporary and traditional dressing.

title: PHOENIX RENEWAL — FLOURISH
subtitle: Green Stone & Crystal Phoenix Brooch
description:
For those ready to grow into what comes next.

A graceful phoenix brooch brought to life with luminous green stones and crystal embellishments. Its upward-reaching form, layered detailing and jewel-like finish create an elegant statement piece that adds colour and character to both contemporary and traditional dressing.

title: FLAMINGO GRACE
subtitle: Crystal-Embellished Flamingo Brooch
description: A sculptural flamingo brooch brought to life with shimmering crystal embellishments and a distinctive red stone accent. Elegant yet expressive, it adds a graceful finishing touch to both traditional and contemporary dressing.

title: VIVID TOUCAN MUSE
subtitle: Crystal-Embellished Toucan Brooch
description: A striking toucan brought to life in a crystal-embellished brooch, celebrating the bird’s distinctive silhouette and naturally vibrant character. Designed to catch the light and the eye, it brings a playful yet sophisticated accent to both traditional and contemporary dressing.

title: GOLDEN INSTINCT
subtitle: Black Metal Squirrel Brooch
description:
For those building wisely for what comes next.

A distinctive squirrel brooch sculpted in black metal and finished with rich golden detailing and black stone embellishments. Its lively form and contrasting finish create a refined statement piece with a sense of character and purpose.

title: FIRE & RADIANCE
subtitle: Red & Orange Crystal Scorpion Brooch
description:
For those ready to channel their strength with purpose.

A striking scorpion brooch adorned with vivid red and orange crystal embellishments. Its sculptural form captures the distinctive character of the scorpion, while the fiery jewel tones give the piece a bold, luminous presence.

title: FLAMINGO AURA
subtitle: Purple Crystal Flamingo Brooch
description:
For those who choose to stand beautifully apart.

A refined flamingo brooch featuring a distinctive purple crystal embellishment. The elegant silhouette is given a jewel-like focal point through the deep, luminous stone, creating a sophisticated statement piece with a subtle sense of individuality.

title: CAT’S EYE
subtitle: Crystal-Embellished Long-Tailed Cat Brooch
description:
For those who see more, notice more and move with intention.

A poised cat brooch defined by a long, sweeping tail, a sharp sculptural silhouette and delicate crystal stone embellishment. Its elegant form captures the feline's distinctive character, creating a refined statement piece with a quiet sense of intelligence and presence.

title: THE INNER KINGDOM
subtitle: Sculptural Silver Multi-Animal Brooch
description:
For those who carry many strengths within.

A one-of-a-kind sculptural brooch crafted in silver metal and delicately embellished with green crystals. Multiple sculpted faces rise organically through the composition, creating a striking interplay of form, texture and perspective. More than an ornament, it is a study in character—layered, distinctive and quietly powerful.
